name: Mid-month joiner: salary pro-rated, insurance in full
source: synthetic — replace with anonymised real cases
derivation: Joined on 17 August 2026. The month asks 22 working days of a full-time person; the joiner's own timesheet has 11 of them, all paid (paidDaysCenti 1100).
The divisor is the month's 22 days, never the person's 11 — dividing by 11 would pay a whole month.
Insurance: uncovered working days = 22 - 11 = 11, below the threshold of 14, so the month is contributed for.
The contribution is NOT pro-rated: it is on the declared insurance salary of 30,000,000, the same as a full month.
